UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Root user profile document for an authenticated Minna Bunpou learner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Optional learner display name shown in the header and account menu.

avatarUrl.description: Optional avatar URL (HTTPS or compressed JPEG/PNG/WebP data URI).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

BunpouBookProgress.title: BunpouBookProgress
BunpouBookProgress.description: Per-book mastered and hard Minna Bunpou pattern IDs synced for a learner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

bookId.description: Minna Bunpou book identifier matching the document ID (n5 or n4).

mastered.description: Unique list of mastered Bunpou pattern IDs belonging to bookId (disjoint from hard).

hard.description: Unique list of hard/review Bunpou pattern IDs belonging to bookId (disjoint from mastered).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this book progress record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest progress sync.

BunpouQuizHistory.title: BunpouQuizHistory
BunpouQuizHistory.description: Per-book compact detailed quiz answer history (up to 30 latest sessions) stored as pure ASCII reference tokens including selected choice and example index.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

bookId.description: Minna Bunpou book identifier matching the document ID (n5 or n4).

sessions.description: Up to 30 compact pure-ASCII quiz session tokens with per-question detailed answer records (V1 legacy and V2 detailed with selectedPatternId & exampleIndex).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this quiz history bucket was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest quiz history sync.

KotobaBookProgress.title: KotobaBookProgress
KotobaBookProgress.description: Per-book mastered and hard Minna Kotoba vocabulary word IDs synced for a learner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

bookId.description: Minna Kotoba book identifier matching the document ID (n5 or n4).

mastered.description: Unique list of mastered Kotoba word IDs belonging to bookId (disjoint from hard).

hard.description: Unique list of hard/review Kotoba word IDs belonging to bookId (disjoint from mastered).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this Kotoba progress record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest Kotoba progress sync.

DailyStudyTracker.title: DailyStudyTracker
DailyStudyTracker.description: Daily memorization goal, streak, and up to 90 days of compact pure-ASCII activity tokens synced for a learner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

dailyGoal.description: Daily memorization goal selected by the learner.

days.description: Up to 90 compact pure-ASCII daily activity tokens (YYYY-MM-DD|quizSessions|id1,id2,...).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the daily tracker document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest daily tracker sync.

/users/{userId}.description: Root profile document for each authenticated learner (Master Gate parent for all subcollections).

/users/{userId}/bunpouProgress/{bookId}.description: Per-book mastered and hard Bunpou pattern progress (n5, n4).

/users/{userId}/quizHistory/{bookId}.description: Per-book compact quiz session history tokens (n5, n4).

/users/{userId}/kotobaProgress/{bookId}.description: Per-book mastered and hard Kotoba vocabulary progress (n5, n4).

/users/{userId}/dailyTracker/{trackerId}.description: Singleton ('state') daily memorization target, streak, and 90-day activity history.
